alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

create or replace function public.is_class_instructor(p_class_id bigint)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
    and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;

create or replace function public.class_enrolled_count(p_class_id bigint)
returns integer
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select count(*)::integer
  from public.class_spots cs
  where cs.class_id = p_class_id
  and cs.status = 'enrolled';
$$;

create or replace function public.class_capacity(p_class_id bigint)
returns integer
language sql
security definer
stable
as $$
  select c.capacity
  from public.classes c
  where c.id = p_class_id;
$$;

create policy classes_select_authenticated
on public.classes
for select
to authenticated
using (true);

create policy class_spots_select_authenticated
on public.class_spots
for select
to authenticated
using (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  or public.is_class_instructor(class_id)
);

create policy class_spots_insert_authenticated
on public.class_spots
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
  and exists (
    select 1
    from public.classes c
    where c.id = class_spots.class_id
    and (
      (status = 'enrolled' and public.class_enrolled_count(class_id) < public.class_capacity(class_id))
      or (status = 'waitlisted' and public.class_enrolled_count(class_id) >= public.class_capacity(class_id))
    )
  )
);

create policy class_spots_update_authenticated
on public.class_spots
for update
to authenticated
using (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  and status = 'waitlisted'
)
with check (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  and status = 'enrolled'
  and public.class_enrolled_count(class_id) < public.class_capacity(class_id)
);

create policy class_spots_delete_authenticated
on public.class_spots
for delete
to authenticated
using (
  user_id = auth.uid()
  or public.is_class_instructor(class_id)
);
